title: Transducers: Sensors and Actuators
lead: Covers lecture 06 and its datasheets: what a transducer is, digital sensors (reed switch, Hall effect, PIR, flame), analog sensors (water level, accelerometer, joystick), analog/digital sensors, actuators (RGB LED, bulb, motor, solenoid, thermoelectric), and how to drive heavy loads with a BJT (BC547), a MOSFET (2N7000), a flyback diode (1N4001) or a relay. Built from the slides, datasheets and peer note page 38.
